transcript: Here's a good example of an install that we're wrapping up today. You can see that we selected specific plants for specific locations. And why that's so important is in five years from now, we don't want you to drive by your home and go, why are those bushes covering my windows when we are trying to avoid that? So we make specific selections to avoid doing that. Basically you have like, for example, green velvet boxwoods. These will grow into about 30 to 36 inches at max. And they're very easy to trim and maintain at that space. This particular crate Myrtle is a Muscogee. And this one will fill in this space above these two windows really well, as well as provide a big plethora of color in the summer. This is a very good full sun, full heat area. So this plant will thrive in this area.
